name: Baseline Nor'easter
description: A single fall nor'easter approaches Boston with 45 mph sustained winds and high outage probability in coastal and high-vulnerability neighborhoods. Twelve battery-electric buses across three depots are mostly idle and well charged, and grid tie-in capacity is generous everywhere except East Boston, whose 100 kW connection fits only one bus. This is the original synthetic scenario the project was built around.
stresses: The engineered conflict between vulnerability priority and one weak grid tie-in: East Boston ranks first on need but can only accept a single bus, forcing the agents to negotiate depth-versus-breadth.
